column1: # quiet-desk (kit-q-quiet-desk): one person alone at a quiet desk meets memory (#7814, first builder, 26 Nov 10:46). One voice
# for every line (the test face's). The runner (off-repo, RUNNER.md) reads this file top to bottom: it sets the face first
# (talk|still|hide; - leaves it), then says the line (say: played, misheard wake word replayed once; mem: a memory line, gated
# on the face read speaking and checked seen after, replayed at most once in all), waits `wait` s; quiet waits with nothing
# said; snap reads the memory (test face, room, owner and rule scopes) into snap_<text>.json. Each tell is said by name; its
# ask comes back without the name, inside the conversation, 30 to 60 s after the tell. A yes is said only when the lamp asked
# (RUNNER.md §2). qd12_q waits until 630 s after qd8_ask (past the thread's REMEMBERED_FOR), so QD12 is a new session told no old exchange. All names and facts are made up.
